picks.thesis: Biggest pure-play quantum name just posted a record beat-and-raise; post-earnings gap is holding and the stock is still half its 6-month high, so the drift can carry it back toward $50-72.
picks.catalyst: Q3 beat-and-raise (Nov 5): revenue $173.8M (+336% y/y), FY26 guide raised to $505-515M, backlog $1.2B. Follow-through: Rigetti/D-Wave prints Nov 10 can extend the sector move.

reasons.text: Record Q3 revenue $173.8M (+336% y/y), FY2026 guidance raised to $505-515M, backlog more than doubled to $1.2B
Stock gapped +23% on Nov 6 and added +8% on Nov 9; 2027 Superion capacity described as sold out. Risk: $83.5M of revenue came from the SkyWater acquisition and adj. EBITDA loss was $133.6M
Management commentary on demand and the $2B equity raise (cash to keep investing)

picks.thesis: AI-cloud operator crushed 65% in a year on financing fears, but revenue is ramping fast and >$4B of contracted, funded ARR goes live Jan-Feb 2027; a relief re-rating toward analyst targets ($30-65) could double it.
picks.catalyst: Microsoft Horizon 2-4 capacity (>$4B contracted ARR) targeted to go live by Jan 31, 2027 (may slip to Feb). Next earnings ~early Feb 2027.

reasons.text: Q1 FY27 revenue $228M (+66% q/q), AI Cloud revenue $200M (+182% q/q) at 86% gross margin, backlog $20.3B, new contracts signed after quarter end
Analysts cut targets on the delay but still see big upside: Cantor $47 (Overweight), Macquarie $55, BTIG $65, Goldman $30 (Neutral)
Main risk: heavy debt (~$10B) and $6B of FY27 capex financing still 'targeted', not committed; stock is in a Stage 4 downtrend, so this is a speculative rebound

picks.thesis: Small robotics name (~$300M cap, ~$198M cash) gapped +39% on a guidance raise and held it; AI/robotics heat plus a new Physical AI Services revenue line could re-rate it toward its $9 high.
picks.catalyst: Q3 beat and FY26 revenue guide raised to $12M (Nov 5), Physical AI Services launch, Australia expansion; Q4 delivery-volume updates and new partner announcements.

reasons.text: Q3 revenue $2.8M (+313% y/y), FY26 guide raised to $12M from $9-10M, opex guide cut to $150M, $198M cash and securities
New Physical AI Services line opens its fleet data/tech to other robot makers
Stock jumped ~39% on Nov 6 and held the gap Nov 9. Main risk: burns ~$40M/quarter and uses ATM offerings (dilution)

picks.thesis: Binary FDA bet: deramiocel for Duchenne decides Nov 22; approval (plus a possible priority review voucher) could send a stock that was $31.90 this year back to $18-30. A rejection likely cuts it in half or worse.
picks.catalyst: FDA PDUFA date Nov 22, 2026 for deramiocel (DMD, upper-limb function label). Q3 results due Nov 10.

reasons.text: FDA decision on deramiocel scheduled for Nov 22 after a 3-month extension for new 24-month HOPE-3 data and a narrower upper-limb label
HOPE-3 cardiac data won an AHA research award (Nov 7); 28 trial physician-scientists wrote FDA urging approval; stock +35% in 5 days
Main risk: FDA advisers voted 9-3 against efficacy (cardiac) in July and the first application was rejected in 2025; a no would gap through the stop. Cash ~$238M (Jun 30)
Date confirmed on the PDUFA calendar
